fraud.text:
(a) Except for the matters(s) referred in the ‘Basis for Qualified Opinion’ of our audit report which are sub-judice and hence are inconclusive, to the best of our knowledge and information and explanations given to us, no fraud by the Company or any fraud on the Company by its officers or employees has been noticed or reported during the year.

(b) During the year, no report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed by the auditors in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government.

(c) During the year, we have taken into consideration the whistle blower complaints, if any, received by the company during the year while determining the nature, timing and extent of audit procedures.

timeline.summary: Jignesh P. Shah declared no encumbrance of shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
63 moons' subsidiary Ticker Ltd reported NCLT directions regarding resolution plan contentions for Baron Infotech.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹133.74 Cr (+880.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹22.5 Cr.
